description: Maps an AIIncidentAnalysis (CONTRACT s4.2) into the normalized Vendetta alert fields of s4.1. Accepts a cs3.ai.inference event (analysis object under `analysis`, plus model/role/fallback/verdict/gpu_seconds/alert_id) or a bare AIIncidentAnalysis. severityAssessment -> severity (lower case) + rule.level (critical 14, high 11, medium 8, low 5); mitreTactic/mitreTechnique -> mitre.tactic[]/mitre.technique[] (+ mitre.id[] when a Txxxx[.xxx] id is present); probableRootCause -> root_cause; recommendedImmediateAction -> recommended_action; confidenceScore -> ai.confidence; engineUsed -> ai.engine; gpuSeconds -> ai.cost.gpu_seconds; ai.role derived from the engine (nemotron=triage, gemma=forensic, Cecur Heuristics=heuristic; the event role is used only for unknown engines); ai.fallback from the event, else true for heuristics. When alert_id is present the output is a pure enrichment of that alert (id = alert_id, no @timestamp/source/description so an update+doc_as_upsert never clobbers the original alert; the event time goes to ai.analyzed_at). Without alert_id a standalone cs3-ai alert is produced (id = request_id). On failure the document is kept and ingest_error is set.

set.description: Ingest time when the event carries no @timestamp.

script.description: Build the alert fields atomically, then replace the AI record with them.
